reviews.title: Irritations that give it 2 stars over 5 stars
reviews.text:
I downloaded this app cause I loved the wallpaper options they offered on here. They are awesome and so diverse!!! But there are flaws/disappointments that keep it from that 5 🌟review. 

1...the Ads after ads after ads and for what.... One coin after a 5-second ( feels like 5 mins) ad. Yes, you need to maintain the app, but to watch 20 ads ( it adds up for each one) for one coin for wallpaper. It gets to be pretty ridiculous. Instead of one coin, have it be 5 or 10, and after 7 days, offer a bonus. Add things, like games (like puzzles) for opportunities to win coins. 

2....disappearing photos. This one probably bugs me the most. Whenever there is a wallpaper of particular interest, but it doesn't have a significant coin amount to get it, the app will refresh every so often. That pic disappears and it is difficult to find again, almost impossible to relocate again. Even if we can’t like our favorites, it would be great to find some way to relocate that pic again. 

3....categories. Would be nice to follow the categories of our favorite wallpapers. 

At the current moment, those are the flaws/disappointments that bug me the most, and some feature(s) could find a solution for them.

reviews.title: Poor customer support for apple users
reviews.text:
I’m really disappointed with the customer support for Wallcraft. I’ve contacted them multiple times via email regarding my active subscription, which is due to renew soon, but I haven’t received any response at all.

I’m trying to cancel my subscription before the renewal date, and this lack of support is extremely frustrating. I don’t even want a refund — I just want to stop the subscription in time, especially since I’m changing my region.

For an app that charges users, basic customer support should be reliable and responsive. Ignoring users who are trying to manage their subscriptions is not acceptable.

I hope the developers take this seriously and improve their support system, because right now it’s a very poor experience.

reviews.title: Waste of time
reviews.text:
Behold, mortals and semi-mortals! I, Count Vain-Design the Ever-Decorated, have discovered the one app more draining than my own bite: a wallpaper app that forces you to watch ads before you can adorn your screen. Yes, even I—an immortal creature of the night with centuries to squander—find myself groaning as yet another cheery commercial interrupts my unholy quest for the perfect background. Do you know how humiliating it is for a centuries-old predator to be held hostage by a jingle about toothpaste?

Still, I must confess… the wallpapers are glorious. Gothic arches, moonlit castles, misty forests—deliciously dramatic! But every time I tap “apply,” I’m condemned to endure another 30 seconds of human advertising. Thirty seconds! That’s practically a decade in vampire impatience. So go ahead, download it—waste your fleeting mortal minutes, just as I waste my eternal ones. Misery loves company, and apparently… so do wallpapers.

I get needing ads to sponsor and pay for the ai they use to generate these photos, but it’s clear they have no respect for the user experience or health of this app. 

They probably have bots that write the app reviews and that’s why this app is number one. You can clearly see how this app wasn’t crafted with quality, only quantity for revenue and to get as many ads in your face as possible.
